svg.title: CareConnect - Browse
svg.desc: One of exactly six screen designs. All shown names, records, amounts and chart values are illustrative layout data. Reference style: white header, teal navigation, pale background and rounded cards.
svg.text: Find patients, clinics and appointments. Select a row to see its details here.

g.inkscape:label: Browse / clinics
g.text: Confirm your clinic and copay on

g.inkscape:label: Browse / patients
g.text: Patient record and balance are read-only.
Choose this patient in the header to book.

g.inkscape:label: Browse / appointments
g.text: Clinic staff can move a visit forward only.
Shown for clinic staff; these actions are
not available in the patient view.

g.inkscape:label: Browse / loading
g.text: Please wait. Existing inputs remain available.

g.inkscape:label: Browse / empty
g.text: Try a different name or ID, or clear your filters.

g.inkscape:label: Browse / error
g.text: We could not load this data
Retry shortly. Your current selection has been kept.

svg.text: Illustrative layout values only. Amounts are HSA account units; the schema specifies no currency.
